description:
This album was recorded and mixed by Heather Kirby at Angles Up and Kirby's Dreamland Studio located in Toronto, Ontario. Additional recordings done by Brooksie, Ira, Tyler and Mikhial in Guelph, Bramalon, Milton and Dyers Bay (Barn). 

Mastering was done by Fedge.

Physical sales of vinyl and CD will be release in the Fall under Out of Sound Records. 

We would like to thank the Ontario Arts Council for partially funding this project!
